newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B shares down in sluggish trading.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B shares down in sluggish trading.

text.p: Shanghai B shares edged down on Tuesday with trade sluggish and sentiment bearish and the A market slipped on a correction in heavy volume, brokers said.
The index fell 0.284 points or 0.59 percent to 47.654 points, on volume of 3.8 million shares worth $1.3 million. Of 41 B shares, 32 traded, with 14 down, 11 flat and seven up.
Brokers said market sentiment had been very gloomy after continuous falls in the past days, with few buyers.
"Overseas selling today seemed to pause after continuous liquidation in the past few days but buying was very weak," one broker said.
"There is no sign the market can break out of its downward track in the short term and the index is likely to fall further in the next few days," a second broker said.
Shanghai Diesel Engine was the biggest loser, down $0.016 or 3.86 percent to $0.398, on volume of 77,000 shares.
Shanghai Dazhong followed on liquidation selling, down $0.020 or 3.22 percent to $0.600, on volume of 112,700 shares.
Shanghai Automation Instrumentation traded the most on intra-institutional trading, ending unchanged at $0.130, on volume of 541,600 shares.
Shanghai A shares lost early gains on profit-taking due to rumours of official measures to curb a market overheated in recent weeks, brokers said.
The A index fell 5.618 points or 0.52 percent to 1072.117 points, on volume of 1.1 billion shares worth 9.4 billion yuan.
The SSE 30 blue-chip index rose 27.955 points or 1.06 percent to 2665.072 points.
Shandong Pestic was the biggest loser, falling 0.59 yuan or 6.56 percent to 8.40 yuan, on volume of 6.6 million shares.
